expected_level_description: You can: - manage diaries, deadlines, and key dates for a team - prepare and format legal documents, bundles, and signing packs - check and process external lawyers' invoices - manage contract and deed registers
You can: - explain the main parts of a contract, such as parties, term, payment, liability, and termination - prepare standard documents from approved templates
You can: - explain the basic principles of data protection and confidentiality - recognise information requests and data breaches and route them correctly
You can: - listen to the needs of design and business stakeholders and interpret information - take part in discussions within a multidisciplinary team
You can: - apply data protection principles to your work - contribute to data protection impact assessments - handle information requests and records correctly
You can: - describe the main parts of the health and care system and the services the organisation supports - explain why patient safety and confidentiality matter in your work
